name: OMedia Controls
author: lancefaul
description: Media controls for any MPRIS player: album art, a seek bar, shuffle and repeat, speed, volume, keyboard shortcuts, hotkey commands, and Winamp's classic spectrum analyser, styled like Omarchy's own panels.

barWidget.description: Album art and track title in the bar; seek, playback controls, volume and a Winamp-style spectrum analyser in the popup.

schema.label: Show spectrum analyser in the popup header
Maximum title width
schema.description: Widest the track title gets in the bar, in logical pixels, before it is elided.

schema.label: Hide widget when nothing is playing
schema.description: Off by default, so the widget stays a stable click target for the popup.

schema.label: Pause other players when one starts
schema.description: Starting playback in one player pauses the rest, like audio focus on a phone. Off by default, since playing a video over music is sometimes the point.
